value: Study population: 15 Yanomami individuals from Brazil (Yanomami/Brazil); compared with 8 Yanomami from Venezuela, 24 Matses, 12 Tunapuco, and 44 US urban individuals
Sequencing method: shotgun metagenomics on HiSeq 2500
Total reads: ~219 million reads, average ~14 million reads per sample
Bioinformatic tools: Kraken for taxonomic classification, LEfSe for biomarker detection, SUPER-FOCUS for functional classification
Ethics approval: Oswaldo Cruz Foundation Ethics Research Committee No. 638/11 and CONEP No. 16907
Study focus: taxonomic and functional characterization of gut microbiome in traditional hunter-gatherers versus urban populations
